chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan, from his father, from Thaʿlabah, from Maʿmar ibn Yaḥyā, from Dāwūd al-Zajjājī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

If a woman is menstruating and becomes pure before sunset, she performs the ẓuhr and ʿaṣr prayers; and if she becomes pure at the end of the night, she performs the maghrib and the latter ʿishāʾ prayer.

key_terms.الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ: the later night prayer, meaning ʿishāʾ
key_terms.حَائِضًا: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ: sunset, marking the end of the daytime prayer window mentioned here

ai.seo_question: What prayers must a menstruating woman make up if she becomes pure before sunset or at the end of the night?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a menstruating woman who becomes pure before the end of certain prayer periods. It states which paired prayers she must perform based on whether her purification occurs before sunset or at the end of the night.
